# @nestjs-pipeline/cache

> 标签: behavior, cache, cache-manager, caching, cqrs, keyv, nestjs, pipeline, redis

## 简介

Caching behavior for the NestJS pipeline — cache-manager v7 on top of Keyv with pluggable stores (memory, redis, memcache, sqlite, postgres).
